# La Villa Coliving

> Premium furnished all-inclusive coliving, 20 minutes from Geneva (French side).

## Key Facts
- 29 furnished rooms across 3 houses (La Villa, Le Loft, Le Lodge)
- Location: Ville-la-Grand, Ambilly, Annemasse (Haute-Savoie, France)
- Price: from CHF 1,380/month, all-inclusive
- Target: Swiss cross-border workers, expats, young professionals
- Amenities: heated pool, sauna, gym, fiber up to 8 Gb/s, coworking, yoga
- 12-month leases, flat-rate charges included (cleaning 2x/week, streaming, fiber, sports classes)
- 100+ residents welcomed since 2021, regular events (pizza nights, yoga classes, afterworks)
- 99% occupancy rate over 5 years

## Properties
- La Villa: 10 rooms, Ville-la-Grand — heated outdoor pool, sauna, gym. CEVA train ~20 min to Geneva center.
- Le Loft: 7 rooms, Ambilly — year-round heated indoor pool, Finnish sauna, gym. Tram 17 stop 5 min away.
- Le Lodge: 12 rooms, Annemasse — largest house, pool house, fitness chalet, pool. Léman Express (CEVA) station ~9 min away.

## Benefits for Cross-Border Workers & Expats
- ≈ CHF 36/m² all-in (38 m² of space per resident), while Geneva studio listings run around CHF 50/m² excluding charges (source: our 2026 Housing Observatory)
- French tax address (cross-border worker advantages)
- All-inclusive = no hidden fees, no utility deposit
- International community, help with settling in — residents from 15+ nationalities

## How to Apply
- 2-minute form at https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/candidature — reply within 48h
- Then: a chat to get to know each other, a house visit, and move-in possible within 2 weeks
- No application fee, no agency fee; deposit of two months' rent excluding charges, returned when you leave
- Direct WhatsApp contact: https://wa.me/33664315134
- Referral: a resident who refers a successful applicant receives €150 (the applicant simply mentions it in the form)

## Open Data — Cross-Border Housing Observatory
- Annual study: studio listing rents crossed with travel time to Geneva Eaux-Vives, for 17 French communes on the Léman Express corridor
- Key 2026 figure: in Geneva, a newcomer pays about +44% per m² vs a sitting tenant (listings ≈ CHF 50/m² vs CHF 35/m² OCSTAT for existing leases)
- Page: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/en/observatoire-logement-frontalier-geneve
- CSV data: https://www.lavillacoliving.com/data/observatoire-data-2026.csv
